[SWS_DM_00151] snapshot record numeration
⌈
In case Diagnos-
ticMemoryDestination.typeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumeration is set to
calculated, the DM shall store freeze frames numbered consecutively starting with 1
in their chronological order. If the parameter is set to configured, the DM shall store
the records based on the DiagnosticFreezeFrame.recordNumber configuration
parameters of the respective freeze frames.
⌋
